name: More Thorium Widgets
label: Quest
description: More Thorium Widgets: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, you have been so good to us, bringing me goods without tiring. You have my eternal thanks!
Although our need for Thorium widgets is not as great as it was, you may still bring them to me and I will gladly trade them for Darkmoon Faire tickets.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here you are, friend. Here are Darkmoon Faire tickets for your enjoyment. Do not, as they say, spend them all in one place!
